newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Q3 economic activity stable - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Israel Q3 economic activity stable - central bank.

text.p: The Bank of Israel's quarterly company survey published on Tuesday said economic activity in the third quarter of the year stabilised at the levels of the two preceding quarters.
The survey said activity in the industrial, trade, transport and communications sectors was stable in the third quarter while activity in the building and hotel industries dropped.

The industrial companies surveyed said their sales to the local market were frozen, while exports had risen at the same rate as the previous two quarters. They also said they had registered a drop in the number of employees.
The hotel industry said there was a significant contraction in the levels of activity mainly because of the security situation.
